summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue by skipping filenames containing null bytes, but it may not fully resolve the root cause.

issues.description: The patch only skips filenames containing null bytes, which might not address the underlying issue causing the presence of such filenames. A more robust solution could involve identifying and fixing the source of the null bytes.
The approach of checking for null bytes in filenames is somewhat ad-hoc and might be considered a workaround rather than a comprehensive fix.
